about: Battle of Wits (was Quiz Battle; Henry, Nov 19) built-in question sets per level (written for Kru). 5 sets of 10 per level; shuffled every game; "All topics" mixes all 50. choices + answer index = multiple choice; answer text = short answer. why = the short explanation shown when the class checks the answers. hidden = the hidden bonuses (2 per round, revealed before the tally; needs = only for rounds with short / choice questions; {n} = a question number, {letter} = a first letter of a right answer). Rounds of 5, played by the shared Battle engine.

intro.title: Battle of Wits
text: 5 questions per round. Your team writes each answer on ONE board.
No shouting answers: keep them secret!

intro.title: Be quick!
text: When it ends, the next question comes by itself.

intro.title: Check together
text: After 5 questions, we check every answer together.
Mark each answer on your board: ✓ or ✗.

intro.title: Hidden bonuses!
text: Before you count, 2 secret bonuses are revealed.
A long word? A full sentence? Extra points!

intro.title: Count your points
text: 1 point for each right answer, plus your bonuses.
Tell your teacher your team’s total.

M.1.quote: yesterday i go to the market and buyed two apple.
M.1.answer: Yesterday I went to the market and bought two apples.

M.1.q: Rewrite as ONE sentence starting with 'Although'.
M.1.quote: It was raining. We went to the park. We had a great time.
M.1.answer: Although it was raining, we went to the park and had a great time.
M.1.why: 'Although' + clause, comma, then the main clause. Accept small differences if the grammar and the comma are right.

M.1.q: Write the correct form of EVERY verb in brackets.
M.1.quote: If I ___ (be) rich, I ___ (buy) a house, but I ___ (be) not rich.
M.1.hint: Write the three words, in order
M.1.why: Second conditional: if + past (were), would + base verb. The last gap is a real present fact: am.

M.1.q: Change the whole sentence to the PAST.
M.1.quote: Every day she gets up at six, makes breakfast and walks to school.
M.1.answer: Every day she got up at six, made breakfast and walked to school.
M.1.why: got up, made and walked: two irregular verbs and one regular verb.

M.1.q: Put the words in order to make TWO correct sentences.
M.1.quote: park / went / to / the / we / Sunday / on   •   playing / were / children / the / happily
M.1.hint: Write both sentences with capitals and periods
M.1.answer: We went to the park on Sunday. The children were playing happily.
M.1.why: Sentence 1: subject + verb + place + time. Sentence 2: past continuous (were playing).

M.1.q: Complete EVERY gap with ONE word.
M.1.quote: She ___ lived here ___ 2015, so she has known her neighbors ___ ten years.
M.1.hint: Write the three words, in order
M.1.why: Present perfect: has lived; since + a point in time (2015); for + a length of time (ten years).

M.2.quote: Last weekend my family and I has visited a beautifull temple. It were very old, and there was many tourist. I enjoyed it so much that i want to go again.
M.2.answer: Last weekend my family and I visited a beautiful temple. It was very old, and there were many tourists. I enjoyed it so much that I want to go again.
M.2.why: visited (not has visited), beautiful, It was, there were, tourists, I (capital).

M.2.q: Join the three sentences into ONE sentence with a relative clause.
M.2.quote: My neighbor is a doctor. She works at the city hospital. She is very kind.
M.2.answer: My neighbor, who is a doctor and works at the city hospital, is very kind.
M.2.why: A relative clause (who ...) with commas for extra information. Accept other correct versions.

M.2.quote: They have cancelled the match because the rain flooded the field.
M.2.answer: The match has been cancelled because the field was flooded by the rain.
M.2.why: Present perfect passive (has been cancelled) and past passive (was flooded).

M.2.q: Put EVERY verb in brackets in the correct tense.
M.2.quote: By the time we ___ (arrive), the movie ___ (already start).
M.2.why: Past simple for the later action; past perfect for the earlier one.

M.2.q: Add ALL the capital letters and punctuation.
M.2.quote: although it was late tom decided to finish his homework he opened his book took a deep breath and started writing
M.2.answer: Although it was late, Tom decided to finish his homework. He opened his book, took a deep breath, and started writing.
M.2.why: A comma after the 'although' clause, a period, and commas in the list of three actions.

M.2.quote: "I'll call you tomorrow if I'm not working," she said to me.
M.2.answer: She told me that she would call me the next day if she wasn't working.
M.2.why: will becomes would, tomorrow becomes the next day, am not becomes was not.

M.3.q: Rewrite the sentence with 'Had' at the start.
M.3.quote: If I had known the truth, I would have acted differently.
M.3.answer: Had I known the truth, I would have acted differently.
M.3.why: 'Had I known' = 'If I had known' (third conditional, no 'if').

M.3.quote: Despite of the rain, we have went to the beach, and the sea were warmer than I have expected.
M.3.answer: Despite the rain, we went to the beach, and the sea was warmer than I had expected.
M.3.why: Despite (no 'of'), went (not have went), was (not were), had expected (past perfect).

M.3.q: Join into ONE sentence using a PARTICIPLE clause.
M.3.quote: She opened the door. She saw a strange package on the floor.
M.3.answer: Opening the door, she saw a strange package on the floor.
M.3.why: A participle clause (Opening ...) shares the subject of the main clause.

M.3.q: Rewrite in the PASSIVE with a reporting verb.
M.3.quote: People say that the company is losing millions.
M.3.answer: The company is said to be losing millions. (or: It is said that the company is losing millions.)
M.3.why: Passive reporting structure: is said to + infinitive, or It is said that...

M.3.q: Fill ALL four gaps with the correct form of the word in brackets.
M.3.quote: The ___ (decide) was a ___ (surprise) to everyone, but the ___ (organize) explained it ___ (clear).
M.3.hint: Write the four words, in order
M.3.why: A noun after 'The', a noun after 'a', a plural noun as the subject, an adverb after the verb.

M.3.quote: I'm sorry I didn't call her yesterday. It's too late now.
M.3.answer: I wish I had called her yesterday.
M.3.why: A regret about the past: wish + past perfect.
